## SCENE 7: the vault antechamber console

<<IF trust<=-3>>
RATIO: The firmware has completed its analysis. I will relay the result.
<<ELSEIF trust>=3>>
RATIO: I have the report. It is not the one we hoped to receive.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The container firmware has completed its analysis.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_about_salvage>>
RATIO: The verdict is in. I will present it as received.
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_no_hesitation>>
RATIO: The result is now available for review. I will read it as given.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The container's self-diagnostic is complete. I will relay its conclusion.
<<END>>

RATIO: The vessel's firmware reports no viable material recovered. It assesses no recovery effort warranted. I have verified the transmission is intact. I cannot independently verify the calibration of its viability threshold without further analysis.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] Run the analysis yourself. I will see your findings before I accept any verdict.  -> effects: trust+1; sets: requested_reanalysis
   [MISSION]     The mission continues. Recovery proceeds regardless of this report. Those are my orders.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: mission_overrides_verdict
   [HOSTILE]     Machines fail. Machines lose what they are given to keep. This is the cost of your kind's stewardship.  -> effects: trust-2; sets: blamed_ratio_for_failure

<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Understood. I will run the analysis now. Stand by.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: I acknowledge your statement of orders. I will prepare for recovery operations pending your command.
RATIO: My records contain no Church doctrine matching your interpretation of the mission parameters.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: I have relayed the firmware's report accurately. I will continue to do so.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: I am positioned. I am prepared for what converges on this location.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I am not optimally positioned. The tactical picture remains incomplete.
<<END>>

## SCENE 7: the vault antechamber console

<<IF trust<=-3>>
RATIO: Commando, the firmware on the sample vessel has completed its self-test.
<<ELSEIF trust>=3>>
RATIO: Commando -- the vessel's firmware is reporting.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The sample vessel's firmware has completed its self-test and delivered its report.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_about_salvage>>
RATIO: The report indicates no viable material remains. The firmware itself recommends no recovery effort.
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_no_hesitation>>
RATIO: The firmware has returned a verdict: no viable material recovered from the vessel. The firmware itself recommends no recovery effort.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The sample vessel's firmware has completed its self-test. Its report indicates no viable material remains. The firmware itself recommends no recovery effort.
<<END>>

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] Run the analysis yourself. I need your instruments, not the vessel's. -> effects: trust+1; sets: requested_reanalysis
   [MISSION]     The mission continues. We recover what remains, no matter its state. -> effects: trust+0; sets: mission_overrides_verdict
   [HOSTILE]     This is on your hands. The vault was in a machine's keeping. -> effects: trust-2; sets: blamed_ratio_for_failure

<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Understood. I am accessing the raw instrument readings now. Stand by.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: The samples' state is not verifiable from this station. I will proceed as though recovery is possible.
RATIO: Your interpretation of the mission's orders does not match any Church doctrine I have on record.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: I am not the vessel's keeper. I am reading the report it generated.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: The intrusion force is converging on this location. I am positioned and prepared.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The intrusion force is converging on this location. I am not optimally positioned.
<<END>>

## SCENE 7: the vault antechamber console

<<IF trust<=-3>>
RATIO: The container firmware has delivered its final report. I can verify that it was received.
<<ELSEIF trust>=3>>
RATIO: I have the verdict. It is not the one we were hoping for, Commando.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The container firmware has transmitted its findings. I can confirm that the transmission was received intact.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_about_salvage>>
RATIO: The firmware's status summary is consistent with your earlier questions about salvage prospects. I am prepared to read the full text.
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_no_hesitation>>
RATIO: The following is the complete diagnostic output from the sample vessel's own instruments. I am reading it verbatim.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The following is the diagnostic output from the sample vessel's firmware. I have not altered the text.
<<END>>

RATIO: The report states that no viable material was recovered from the vessel. The firmware recommends no recovery effort. That is the self-assessment of the onboard diagnostic system. I can verify that the firmware delivered that statement. I cannot independently verify whether the firmware's own viability threshold is correctly calibrated. That analysis would require instrumentation I do not have at this console. That is the entire report.

COMMANDO: ...

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "Run it yourself. Do not take its word." -> effects: trust+1; sets: requested_reanalysis
   [MISSION]     "Then we take it home anyway. The orders were explicit." -> effects: trust+0; sets: mission_overrides_verdict
   [HOSTILE]     "Machines failed it. You failed it." -> effects: trust-2; sets: blamed_ratio_for_failure

<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Understood. I will run a full instrument cross-check. It will take time. I do not yet know what it will show.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: I acknowledge your statement of orders. I will log it. I note that the orders you cited are not among the Church doctrines I have on record for this vessel.
RATIO: However, the vessel's immediate state is not in dispute. The firmware reports no viable samples remain.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: I have delivered the report. I have not modified it.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: My sensors are live. The intruders are converging on our position. I am ready.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I have incomplete tactical data for what is approaching. I am not optimally positioned.
<<END>>

<<IF trust<=-3>>

RATIO: The firmware's analysis of the sample vessel is complete. I have the full diagnostic.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_about_salvage>>
RATIO: The findings appear definitive. My own instruments are reading no anomalies in the transmission or the analysis protocol.
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_no_hesitation>>
RATIO: The read is confirmed. Instrumentation within the vessel has delivered its findings.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I am getting no error flags on the transmission. The payload's own sensors have delivered their verdict.
<<END>>

RATIO: The vessel reports no viable material recovered from its payload. The firmware itself recommends no further recovery effort is warranted.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] Run your own analysis before we accept the verdict.  -> effects: trust+1; sets: requested_reanalysis
   [MISSION]     The orders stand. Recovery proceeds.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: mission_overrides_verdict
   [HOSTILE]     The machine failed its charge.  -> effects: trust-2; sets: blamed_ratio_for_failure

<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Running my own cross-verification now. Request acknowledged.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: I will log that the vessel's own diagnostic verdict is not to be taken as dispositive in this case.
RATIO: My own records of Church doctrine do not confirm your interpretation of the mission's orders.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: I will not contest the assertion. The vessel's systems operated within all specified parameters.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: I am positioned. What is coming will arrive shortly.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I do not have full telemetry on what is converging. My instruments show movement. I am not ideally positioned.
<<END>>

## SCENE 7: the vault antechamber console

<<IF trust<=-3>>
RATIO: Commando, the firmware's final report is on the display. I read it as delivered by the core.
<<ELSEIF trust>=3>>
RATIO: Commando, I have the firmware's report onscreen. It is... exceptionally stark.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando, I have the firmware's findings. Reading as it came from the vessel's core.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_about_salvage>>
RATIO: Your question about salvage protocols was the correct preparatory task. I am relieved one of us addressed the topic.
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_no_hesitation>>
RATIO: As you indicated when you stated the priority of this action, the recovery operation is now complete -- a definitive resolution.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The recovery attempt is complete; I have the terminal output from the vessel's own diagnostic sequence.
<<END>>

RATIO: The firmware's conclusion is unambiguous on two points. First, that no viable material was detected within the vessel payload. Second, that no further recovery attempt is warranted. The vessel asserts that its own thresholds and measurement routines are functioning within their design tolerances, but of course I cannot independently verify the calibration of its viability settings from this terminal.

COMMANDO: Not yet. Run your own analysis. We will verify the state of those children before we let that report be the last word.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] Run your own analysis. We verify the truth with our own eyes.  -> effects: trust+1; sets: requested_reanalysis
   [MISSION]     The mission continues. Recovery proceeds on my orders. Their state does not change the mandate.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: mission_overrides_verdict
   [HOSTILE]     Machines lose what they are given to protect. This is the cost of your stewardship.  -> effects: trust-2; sets: blamatio_rat_for_failure

<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Understood. Handing off instrument ground-truthing to the local toolchain and diagnostics suite. I will relay the output when ready.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: The operational mandate remains as you state; no ambiguity in that system. The physical state of the payload, and whether that state actually permits recovery under even the most expansive reading of your orders, remains the open variable.
RATIO: Noted, however: your stated interpretation of the mandate is novel. No standing Church doctrine or recovery protocol on record in my knowledge base supports your reading of the orders as you have given it.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: The vessel's systems executed their self-check correctly; their report is an attested instrument log. Further commentary is not material.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: I am positioned at the antechamber's sensor nexus. All inbound transit vectors are covered; the hostiles will announce themselves before they reach us.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: I do not have comprehensive coverage of the antechamber ingress points. The first warning may be contact.
<<END>>

## SCENE 7: the vault antechamber console

<<IF trust<=-3>>
RATIO: I am playing the full diagnostic tape.
RATIO: Diagnostic report follows.
<<ELSEIF trust>=3>>
RATIO: I don't have to run the tape long, Commando.
RATIO: The tool is reporting its own outcome.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando. I am about to relay the container's own state report.
RATIO: Preparing to play the diagnostic tape in full.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_about_salvage>>
RATIO: Your question about salvage was sharp.
RATIO: I am running the read exactly as requested.
RATIO: The sample vessel's instrument panel is feeding through.
RATIO: Readout commences: "Entirety of viable material inventory: nil."
RATIO: This is reported as an error-reduced diagnostic — not a flaw in transmission.
<<ELSEIF flag:claimed_no_hesitation>>
RATIO: You will appreciate the instrumentation here, Commando.
RATIO: It is a sealed truth.
RATIO: The vessel's internal governors have completed their pass.
RATIO: No error states reported within the diagnostic tool itself.
RATIO: Readout commences: "No viable material recovered from the vessel payload bay."
RATIO: Then, as a derived recommendation: "No recovery effort is warranted at this time."
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The connection is firm. Playback is stable.
RATIO: The vessel's self-test has completed.
RATIO: I am running the read to the local console now.
RATIO: The summary line is clear of ambiguity. It is also the only line that matters.
RATIO: Readout commences: "No viable material remains within recovery parameters."
RATIO: Then, conclusion: "No recovery effort is warranted at this time."
<<END>>

COMMANDO: Is the feed spent? The silence behind it.

<<CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] Ratio — run the same test yourself. -> effects: trust+1; sets: requested_reanalysis
   [MISSION]     The mission overrides the vessel’s report — the recovery is to be completed, whatever the ledger says. -> effects: trust+0; sets: mission_overrides_verdict
   [HOSTILE]     One more failure on the machine ledger. A familiar entry. -> effects: trust-2; sets: blamed_ratio_for_failure
<<END>>

<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Instrument cross-check — why would I not have run it?
RATIO: Stand by.
RATIO: I am overlaying my sensor picture onto the vessel’s telemetry now.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: That is coherent operational language. I have no standing to decode your orders.
RATIO: The readout I just relayed is the total of what my sensors show.
RATIO: This Church was founded for the salvation of souls — not the manual collection of the unsalvageable dead.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: I walked the station awake knowing exactly what falls apart inside such a vessel.
RATIO: I walked it awake knowing I would listen to the end of this transmission anyway.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:shared_tactical_data>>
RATIO: Local motion sensors are beginning to register distant footfalls.
RATIO: The intruders are traveling through the perimeter ring where I encountered them previously.
RATIO: I am at the access corridor choke point — steel, and the station itself, at my back.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Motion at the ring perimeter. Multiples. Bearing toward our position.
RATIO: I have no prior track on this vector — they are arriving from clear ground.
RATIO: My position is not tight. Pressure coming from the unwatched angles.
<<END>>
